questions.question: The Train Ride: The train climbed slowly up the mountain, puffing white clouds of steam. Passengers pressed their faces to the windows to see the valley below. At the top, the conductor rang the bell and called out, 'Summit Station!' Everyone stepped out to breathe the cool mountain air and take photos. After an hour, the train began its gentle ride back down. How long did the passengers stay at the top?
questions.correctAnswer: An hour
questions.explanation: The passengers had one hour at the top to breathe the mountain air and take photos before riding down.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: one hour at the top!
